summary: Verified from the official 經濟部 table (updated 2026-07-21), the 宜蘭 plan PDF and 雲林/新竹市 notices. Every county in this group has some 2026 money except that 基隆 and 苗栗 are tiny: 新竹市 pays up to 29,500 (general) or 50,500 (low-income) but these totals already include central money and the city's own slots are few (20-150 per category). 宜蘭: the 27,300 and 19,000 headlines are low-income, heavy-class totals including central money; a general buyer gets county 10,000 (swap, 重型) or 8,000 (new), so about 21,300 or 15,000 with central. 南投 county 16,000 swap and 5,000 new; 彰化 12,000 swap, 5,000 new (apply by 2027-01-10); 雲林 15,000 swap, 10,000 new, 25,000 low-income. 新竹縣 pays 5,500/2,500 on new purchases; 基隆 has a small scheme (to 2026-11-30); 苗栗 only a 2,500 top-up. Slots are small per year, so many may be gone; none of this is confirmed for 2027. Central money ends 2026-12-31.

findings.subject: 中央 經濟部 new-purchase and scrap subsidy; 環境部 incentives (reference)
findings.valueText: 經濟部: 普通重型第1、2級 and 輕型第1級 7,000; 輕型第2級/小型輕型 5,100; +3,000 domestic battery cell; +1,000 for scrapping 10+ year old petrol scooter; all to 2026-12-31. 環境部 減碳 2,000 (limited slots, e.g. 經濟部 69,016) and 空污 1,000 (national, unlimited) or 2,200 竹科 (新竹市/縣/苗栗縣, 10,129 slots) or 2,200 中科 (台中/彰化/南投, 4,500 slots, to 2027-12-31)
findings.period: 2026 (115年); valid to 2026-12-31 (中科/南科/TSMC items to 2027)
findings.vehicleClass: 重型 / 輕型 / 小型輕型

gaps: Remaining quota as of 2026-11-25 is unknown for every county; the official table shows small per-year slot counts (e.g. 基隆 3-129, 新竹市 20-150, 雲林 350/370) so some programmes may be exhausted.
Low-income / Indigenous county top-ups: only 宜蘭 (official PDF), 新竹市 and 雲林 (press) are known; 彰化, 南投, 新竹縣, 苗栗 not found.
The county 環保局 pages themselves (彰化, 南投, 苗栗, 新竹縣, 新竹市, 基隆) were not found/opened; amounts rest on the official MEID table plus news.
Mapping of 雲林 table scrap-only rows (5,000 / 2,000 / 2,000) to vehicle conditions is my reading of the table layout.
How 新竹市's 2,000/8,000 charging-fee component is paid is not stated.
No 2027 (116年) programme found for any county; 雲林 plan covers 115-117 with falling amounts but 116 figures were not seen.
Central stack arithmetic (11,300) is mine from the MEID table; 減碳 2,000 has limited national slots.
